compute_returns_paths: compute discounted returns for RL trajectory paths using a discount gamma factor
compute_advantages_standard: compute advantages for RL paths by subtracting baseline predictions from returns
compute_advantages_gae: compute generalized advantage estimation for RL paths using GAE lambda and TD deltas
compute_advantages_normalize: compute and normalize advantages across all RL paths using mean and standard deviation
discount_sum_sequence: compute the discounted cumulative sum of a reward sequence backwards with a gamma factor
